X-Request-Id.description: The request's correlation id: a valid incoming X-Request-Id (1-128 characters of [A-Za-z0-9._-]) or a generated one

properties.description: Template properties that help the consumer render the message

template.description: Optional template identifier used by downstream consumers; may be null in local outbox payloads

NotificationEmailDto.description: A commerce email sent (or being sent) to a customer

StoredEmail.description: An email captured by the local outbox instead of being sent to the JMS queue

destination.description: Queue it would have been sent to

payload.description: The email, exactly as it would have been sent

additionalProperties.description: Validation messages keyed by field name; invalid arguments use the error key

ValidationErrorsDto.description: Validation messages keyed by field name; invalid arguments use the error key

events.description: Event types to receive; see GET /api/v1/webhooks/event-types

url.description: Public http(s) endpoint on port 80 or 443, or inbox://<token> of one of your inboxes

WebhookDeliveryDto.description: One event sent to a webhook subscription and the outcome of its last attempt

durationMs.description: Duration of the last attempt in milliseconds

eventId.description: Event id (the payload's id); shared by redeliveries of the same event

lastStatusCode.description: HTTP status of the last attempt, if a response arrived

nextAttemptAt.description: When the next retry is due (PENDING only)

payload.description: The exact JSON body that was signed and sent

responseSnippet.description: First 500 characters of the last response body

WebhookEventTypeDto.description: An event type a webhook can subscribe to

name.description: Wire name used in events[] and X-Webhook-Event

WebhookInboxRequestDto.description: A webhook request received by an inbox

consecutiveFailures.description: Failed attempts since the last successful delivery; 20 disables the subscription

disabledReason.description: Why the subscription was disabled automatically

secret.description: Signing secret. Returned only by create and rotate-secret; store it, it is never shown again.

WebhookUpdateDto.description: Replacement settings of a webhook subscription

active.description: Enable or disable deliveries; null keeps the current value. Re-enabling an auto-disabled subscription resets its failure counter.

url.description: Public http(s) endpoint on port 80 or 443, or inbox://<token> of one of your inboxes

info.description: User webhooks (subscriptions, signed deliveries, inboxes) and commerce emails. Uses the access tokens issued by the backend. Requests may carry X-Request-Id and a W3C traceparent; every response answers X-Request-Id.
info.title: Notification Service API

get.description: Administrators list every user's subscriptions by id, optionally for one username. Secrets are never included. Negative page is clamped to zero; size is clamped to 1–100.

403.description: Administrator role required, or configured X-Local-Outbox-Key is missing or invalid

404.description: The local outbox is not in use (JMS transport)

get.description: Oldest first, exactly as they would have been sent to the JMS queue. Requires an administrator and, when LOCAL_EMAIL_OUTBOX_ACCESS_KEY is set, X-Local-Outbox-Key.

403.description: Administrator role required, or configured X-Local-Outbox-Key is missing or invalid

404.description: The local outbox is not in use (JMS transport)

get.summary: Fetch the commerce emails captured by the local outbox

get.description: Commerce emails of the caller, newest first, with the recipient masked. Administrators may pass username to read another user's. Negative page is clamped to zero; size is clamped to 1–100.

403.description: username names another user and the caller is not an administrator

get.description: Returns the caller's inboxes, oldest first.

post.description: Creates a receiver addressed as inbox://<token>. Use that URL in a subscription; deliveries to it are signed and logged like HTTP deliveries but stored here. At most 3 inboxes per user.

delete.description: Deletes the inbox and its requests. Subscriptions that target it fail until they are updated.

404.description: Inbox not found (or it belongs to another user)

get.description: Requests delivered to the inbox with their headers and body, newest first; the last 50 are kept.

404.description: Inbox not found (or it belongs to another user)

get.description: Returns the caller's subscriptions, oldest first. Secrets are never included.

post.description: Subscribes a public http(s) URL on port 80 or 443 (or inbox://<token> of one of your inboxes) to your order events. URLs resolving to loopback, private, link-local or other internal addresses are rejected. The response contains the signing secret, which is shown only once. At most 5 subscriptions per user.

400.description: Invalid body, unknown event type or rejected URL

get.description: Event names a subscription can list in events[]; each is also sent as X-Webhook-Event.

delete.description: Deletes the subscription and its delivery log.

403.description: The subscription belongs to another user

get.description: Returns one of the caller's subscriptions.

403.description: The subscription belongs to another user

put.description: Replaces url, events and description; active=false pauses deliveries and active=true re-enables an (auto-)disabled subscription and resets its failure counter. The URL is checked again. The secret is unchanged.

400.description: Invalid body, unknown event type or rejected URL

403.description: The subscription belongs to another user

get.description: Delivery log of a subscription, newest first, optionally filtered by status. Negative page is clamped to zero; size is clamped to 1–100.

403.description: The subscription belongs to another user

get.description: Returns one delivery with its payload, last status code, error and response snippet.

403.description: The subscription belongs to another user

post.description: Sends the event of an earlier delivery again, now, as a new delivery with the same event id and body and a fresh signature. The original delivery is unchanged.

201.description: Redelivery sent; the new delivery shows the outcome

403.description: The subscription belongs to another user

post.description: Replaces the signing secret and returns the new one once. Later deliveries, including retries of earlier events, are signed with it.

200.description: Secret rotated; new secret included once

403.description: The subscription belongs to another user

post.description: Sends a webhook.ping event now (waiting up to 5 seconds for the receiver) and returns the recorded delivery. A failed ping is retried like any other delivery.

201.description: Ping sent; the delivery shows the outcome

403.description: The subscription belongs to another user
